documents.text: Asana is a project management platform used by teams to organize tasks, manage projects, track progress and collaborate. It offers a free Personal plan and paid plans with additional features. Teams can use project views, task assignments, automation and reporting capabilities.

Trello is a project management tool based on boards, lists and cards. It helps teams organize their work visually. Trello offers a free plan and paid subscriptions with additional features such as automation, advanced views and administrative controls.
Asana provides task management, project timelines, workflow automation, reporting and team collaboration features. It is useful for teams managing multiple projects and tracking dependencies.
Trello uses a Kanban-style interface where tasks move across lists representing different stages of work. Teams can assign members, set deadlines, attach files and automate repetitive workflows.
